examples: Find the error message an agent printed three screens ago.
Jump back to where a test run started.
how_to: Open search and type. Matches in the session's scrollback are highlighted.
Step through them with the up and down arrows; Esc closes it.
name: Search in the terminal
summary: find text in a session's own scrollback without leaving the terminal.
where: Open a session, then the magnifier in the header (on a phone, search in the terminal tools menu).
Or press Ctrl+F (Cmd+F on a computer) in the terminal.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
